primitives.name: Fast Track Request
primitives.verbatim_quote: Reply with one word ("go") and your priority sport if you want to fast-track review.
primitives.assumptions: Request is valid only when A=1; S is a known categorical variable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If A ≠ 1, request ignored; if S undefined, lane suspended.

layer2.mapping: GSE action kernel maps A→S to trigger early-state transition in GSI belief engine.
layer2.telemetry: Binary flag A and categorical S recorded as input to state transition function.

primitives.name: Owner Gate Approval
primitives.verbatim_quote: If your current workflow has changed, reply with the biggest uncertainty you are trying to remove.
primitives.assumptions: G = 1 implies process continuation; U is bounded and measurable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If G ≠ 1, process halts until G = 1; U > threshold triggers uncertainty resolution.

layer2.mapping: GSI uncertainty reduction P(U|new_workflow) aligns with GSE conditional state update P(state_new|state_old, action).
layer2.telemetry: Gate status G and uncertainty U tracked via workflow change log.
